messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — Nimbus Health brought up a few onboarding/product gaps on today's call. Dumping notes here so we can triage and pick the top things to act on. TL;DR: bulk prompt/template import, per-key usage attribution for billing, and a webhook for import status updates.

TJ (CS Ops): Short list with frequency/severity from our call: 1) Bulk template upload (high freq, blocks onboarding) 2) Usage-by-API-key for customer billing (medium freq, high-impact for finance) 3) Onboarding docs/examples for model routing (high friction) 4) Webhook for import/job status (low freq but big UX).

Maya (CS): Notes from customer verbatim: "We have 200+ prompt templates to onboard; doing them manually is killing the rollout timeline." Also: "Our finance team needs per-route and per-key breakouts to reconcile spend with SKU." They asked if there's a way to get a status callback when an import finishes so they can automate enabling routes.

Oliver (PM): Thanks. Can we map each ask to: (a) customer-visible impact, (b) short spec estimate (S/M/L), (c) suggested priority (P0/P1/P2)? If we can get that here, I'll fold into next roadmap sync. Also please file triage form: https://redwood-internal/triage-form — add a short repro + sample payload where relevant.

Maya (CS): Quick stab: 1) Bulk template import — impact: blocks rollout; estimate: M; priority: P0. 2) Per-key usage attribution — impact: billing reconciliation; estimate: L; priority: P1. 3) Onboarding model-routing docs — impact: onboarding time; estimate: S; priority: P0. 4) Webhook for import status — impact: automation; estimate: S; priority: P2.

Lina (Product Eng): For the bulk import, can you paste a representative JSON payload of what they want to upload? If it's large we just need shape + a sample of 3 items. Also, is this one-time migration or ongoing sync?

Maya (CS): Sample payload from customer (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/templates/bulk
Content-Type: application/json
[
  { "id": "welcome_1", "template": "Welcome, {{user_name}}!", "tags": ["onboard", "email"] },
  { "id": "summary_v1", "template": "Here is the summary: {{summary}}", "tags": ["report"] },
  { "id": "billing_alert", "template": "Your usage is {{usage}} tokens", "tags": ["billing"] }
]
```
They said it's a one-time initial import but they'll want re-imports for template updates occasionally.

TJ (CS Ops): I'll own the billing attribution prototype. Plan: add per-api-key breakdown to per-route usage export and expose CSV. Tentative owner: TJ (CS Ops).

Lina (Product Eng): I'll take the bulk import work and sketch a small API spec for a `POST /templates/bulk` with idempotency and per-item status. Owner: Lina (Product Eng).

Maya (CS): I'll own creating a short onboarding doc/rotating examples pack and link into the onboarding flow. Owner: Maya (CS).

Oliver (PM): Nice. Can we convert the above into three tickets: BULK-108 (bulk import), BILL-72 (per-key billing export), ONB-54 (docs + routing examples). Add estimates and a short spec. If we agree, I'll add to the sprint planning board.

cs-bot: Created ticket BULK-108 and BILL-72 in Jira: https://redwood-internal/jira/BULK-108, https://redwood-internal/jira/BILL-72 — assigned to Lina and TJ respectively.

Maya (CS): Awesome — please mark P0 for BULK-108 and ONB-54. Customer asked for a tentative ETA in the next 2 weeks for the import MVP. I'll update Nimbus that we've started work. :thumbsup:
